## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm test:unit`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] Browser tests were added or run when the user interface changed, or they are not applicable.

## Data and privacy

- [ ] No credentials, private account code, personal markers, user backups or environment files are included.
- [ ] Public-data changes include stable IDs, provenance and a reviewable source.
- [ ] Unknown map positions remain `position: null`; no coordinates were inferred from real-world analogues.

## Additional context

Link related issues and include screenshots only when they do not expose private information.
